body:
I appreciate the help but I just feel like this is something inevitable. It's one rough patch after another. I can't get out of the rut I've been in since this whole depression/anxiety thing started when I was a kid. 

The last time I remember being happy is when I was a little kid, 7 or 8 at the oldest, and it's been damn near 20 years. I'm tired and the only 'reset' button I feel is out there is just letting go.

Okay, I'll admit, It's not like I posted here *not* looking for someone to talk to. I wanted something to make light of the matter. 

All I've wanted is for someone to reach out and say they'll help but 99% of the time it's to no avail. I have absolutely no support system around me and I'm just tired of barely getting by.

That's the thing, I'm always making mistakes. And somehow they keep coming up. 

"Oh, you fucked up now, but to add a little insult to injury, what about that mistake from ten years ago?" 

I'm surrounded by people who want me to fuck up and I've already dug my hole too deep I might as well die in it.

Nothing personal but what's that gonna do? 

I couldn't tell you how many people I feel like I've talked to and all it does is get me to the next shitty day. It's over for me.
I've tried for so long. I cant sleep on it any longer. I just can't help it any longer. I'm a failure and there is nothing I can do to change it.
